title: Symplectic Annihilator Finite Quotient
body_html:
Symplectic Annihilator Finite Quotient

Let \(W\) be a symplectic \(F\)-space and fix an additive character \(\psi:F\to\mathbb C^\times\). For a lattice \(L\subset W\), define the \(\psi\)-annihilator \[ L^{\perp_\psi}=\{w\in W:\psi(\langle w,l\rangle)=1\text{ for all }l\in L\}. \] If \(L^{\perp_\psi}\subseteq L\), then \[ \ell_L=L/L^{\perp_\psi} \] is a finite symplectic space. The stabilizer \[ K_L=\{k\in\operatorname{Sp}(W):kL=L\} \] acts on \(\ell_L\), and the subgroup \[ K_L^+=\{k\in K_L:(k-1)L\subseteq L^{\perp_\psi}\} \] is the kernel of the reduction map \(K_L\to\operatorname{Sp}(\ell_L)\).

The notation \(L^{\perp_\psi}\) is used here to avoid confusing the symplectic annihilator with the hermitian dual \(L^\#\).
